description: This file defines the 'BidiFirefox' class which extends 'BrowserType', providing functionality for connecting, configuring, and managing Firefox browsers within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for environment setup, graceful shutdown, handling startup logs, and specific Firefox options.
